objective: Short adaptive intake that preserves all clinically material safety inputs

stages.label: Objetivo principal
stages.presentation: multi-select with no more than three priorities

stages.label: Datos básicos
stages.presentation: short one-at-a-time cards; pregnancy/lactation applicability must not be inferred from reference sex

stages.label: Seguridad
stages.presentation: conditional follow-ups, but all safety categories explicitly assessed; unknown is never equivalent to no

stages.label: Hábitos relevantes
stages.presentation: ask only when relevant to goals and candidate nutrient evaluation

stages.label: Aclaraciones necesarias
stages.presentation: triggered by risk or insufficient exposure evidence

stages.label: Revisá tus respuestas
stages.presentation: show risk-critical answers, missing data and explicit disclosure; no dosing while validation pending

required_new_fields.reason: ingredient per unit cannot yield daily exposure without daily units
free text does not establish exact drug class

behavior.unknown_answer: preserve UNKNOWN and block personalized recommendations
behavior.branching: questions added only when needed; preserve stable canonical IDs
behavior.completion: show unanswered safety items and refuse unsafe personalization

review_needed: map all 87 conditions to response types and options
verify safety followups and medication names
user test with at least five simulated intake profiles
professional review of every clinical trigger
